warn.badPosition: A joint's position can't be worked out: {reason}
warn.leftOut: {bar} is left out: one of its joints has a bad position
warn.spanSetting: A joint setting on a bar's span (a T-joint) is ignored: bars there always butt
warn.throughMissing: A joint's 'runs through' bar isn't at that joint; using the automatic choice
warn.miterCount: Miters join 2 or 3 bars; {n} meet at one joint, so they butt
warn.overlap: {a} and {b} overlap along the same line
warn.shallow: {a} meets {b} at a very shallow angle; its end is left square
warn.alongBar: {bar}: a cut would run along the bar; its end is left square
warn.usedUp: {bar} is used up by its joints (too short for the bars around it)

expr.tooFar: it's more than 100 m from the origin

editor.noFrameText: Start one from the assembly's menu on the Build tab.
editor.smallScreen: Look around and check the cut list here. To change the frame, open it on a larger screen.

drag.mid: Middle of {bar}: release for a T-joint
drag.aligned: Lined up with a joint on {axes}

drawHint.start: Click a joint, a bar or the {where, select, grid {grid} other {floor}} to start a bar.
drawHint.next: Click to place the next joint, or type a length

inspector.tipSnaps: Snaps to joints, the middle of a bar, along a bar (a T-joint) and the X / Y / Z directions.
inspector.tipClick: A click places a point; dragging moves the view (turns it in 3D, pans in Front / Side / Top).
inspector.tipFlat: Front, Side and Top are the easiest to draw in: everything stays on one flat plane.
inspector.outsideHint: Bars sit inside the lines: the frame measures exactly these sizes on the outside.
inspector.centerlineHint: Lines run through the middle of each bar.
inspector.frameHelp: Click a bar to change it, a joint to drag it or change how it's cut, or a size on the model to type a new one. Press L to draw bars.
inspector.lengthHint: Moves the end with fewer bars on it. An end tied to a size (W, H…) changes that size.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.jointSub: {n, plural, one {# bar ends} other {# bars meet}} here: {names}.
inspector.runsThroughHint: The other bars stop at its face.

section.title: Section · where the line runs
section.automatic: Automatic: {point}, keeping the frame's outside sizes.

depth.hint: Where new bars go in this view. Starting at a joint uses its depth.

dialog.title: Design a frame in 3D
dialog.replacing: Pick a starting shape and sizes. Its bars replace this assembly's {n, plural, one {# typed part} other {# typed parts}} (undo brings them back).
dialog.fresh: Pick a starting shape and sizes. You can change everything later in the 3D view.
